title: Learn with Saraswati
line: Before study, writing, music or any creative work.
intro: Saraswati is knowledge, speech and the arts: the flowing river of learning. She is honoured before study and creative work, by students, writers and musicians alike.
offering: A white flower, your books or instrument, an hour of real attention.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: See her
steps.text: This verse describes her: white as jasmine and the moon, holding the veena, seated on a white lotus.

steps.title: Before you begin
steps.text: Repeat this prayer before you begin your work: I begin my learning; may it come to fruition.

steps.title: Your work today
steps.prompt: What do I want to learn, make or say today?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: She is especially honoured on Vasant Panchami.
